text: It comes in two forms. Fibres are very long, narrow cells with pointed ends, in bundles. Jute, flax and hemp are fibres from the phloem, and so is allo, the Himalayan nettle, whose fibres are woven into cloth in Sankhuwasabha and Bajhang.
